from itertools import combinations
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3, Cadical153, Minisat22
n=20
# variable id for edge (i,j) 0-index lex maybe 1-based
edge_to_var={}
var_to_edge={}
v=1
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        edge_to_var[(i,j)]=v
        var_to_edge[v]=(i,j)
        v+=1
clauses=[]
# no red K5: red=0, blue=1, var True means blue. at least one blue among K5 edges
for S in combinations(range(n),5):
    clauses.append([edge_to_var[(i,j)] for i,j in combinations(S,2)])
# no blue K4: at least one red -> one var false, clause negative edges
for S in combinations(range(n),4):
    clauses.append([-edge_to_var[(i,j)] for i,j in combinations(S,2)])
print('vars',v-1,'clauses',len(clauses))
# Try solver
for Solver in [Cadical153, Glucose3, Minisat22]:
    try:
        s=Solver(bootstrap_with=clauses)
    except Exception as e:
        print(Solver, 'init fail', e); continue
    print('solving', Solver)
    ok=s.solve()
    print('ok',ok)
    if ok:
        model=set(l for l in s.get_model() if abs(l)<=190)
        sol=[1 if var in model else 0 for var in range(1,191)]
        print(sol)
        # verify
        def col(i,j): return sol[edge_to_var[(min(i,j),max(i,j))]-1]
        bad=[]
        for S in combinations(range(n),5):
            if all(col(i,j)==0 for i,j in combinations(S,2)): bad.append(('red5',S)); break
        for S in combinations(range(n),4):
            if all(col(i,j)==1 for i,j in combinations(S,2)): bad.append(('blue4',S)); break
        print('bad',bad,'sum blue',sum(sol))
        raise SystemExit
